| # | id | card | priority | wake_at |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `76b7c8e2-9e84-4704-831d-acdfb5640b15` | IT team · verify the efforts feature end to end | high | 2026-11-20T08:39Z |
| 2 | `25822947-0f8f-442d-87d0-d207c118b76e` | IT team · remediate the committed .env / ACME key finding | high | 2026-11-19T08:39Z |
| 3 | `e5df5856-8c28-4c63-996c-b98462cbf83d` | IT team · normalize task-board column names to the standing order | medium | 2026-11-20T08:39Z |

Evidence: the five `create_task` calls returned `status: created` with `board: "IT team"`, `column: "Inbox"`, `profiles: ["software_developer"]` and the ids above. No repository file was changed (control-plane only), so no test command applies to this card.

Selection basis (all verified, not assumed): `repository_overview` → branch `main`, **5 ahead**, dirty; `project_changes scope=all` → 9 files changed, notably the uncommitted efforts feature, the uncommitted `demo/README.md` + `demo/up.sh` and the staged `docs/delivery-contract.md`; prior shift finding of the `.env`/ACME key.

Moving this card to `IT team/Review` and clearing its `wake_at` (the card's own scope is complete; closing it is left to the user per the standing order "never close your own card").

## QA review — 2026-11-18 shift

```
## Decision: allow
- Scope: control-plane only (no repository file changed) — nothing to map or execute
- Evidence: 5 deliverable cards independently confirmed present on `IT team` via `project_manager list_boards/list_tasks`: 76b7c8e2 (efforts e2e), 25822947 (.env/ACME remediation), e5df5856 (column names), 2e3bc02e (demo env), 35c07cbc (delivery-contract gap). Each has context + a measurable acceptance criterion.
- Findings: 0 for this card (the project-wide gate still reports 12: 1x tests.no-suite high, 11x change.missing-tests medium — none caused by this card)
- Blocking item: none
- Owner: n/a
- Next command: `qa_review_changes(scope="all")` on the actual delivery cards, not this one
```

**One metadata inconsistency, not a blocker:** the card sits in `Review` with `status: todo` while `progress: 100`. Nothing in the criterion requires work, so the verdict stays `allow`; leaving it in `Review` for the owner to close (QA never closes another owner's card).
